analysis.summary: SEDA-COG is seeking contractor bids for vinyl siding and facia replacement at their main office building in Lewisburg, PA. Proposals are due September 30th, 2024. SEDA Foundation Inc. is seeking a contractor to replace siding, fascia, louvers, and accents at their main office building. The project must comply with 2024 ICC Building Codes. Permits, plans, and material disposal costs are the contractor's responsibility. Proposals should include a project schedule and an initial estimate detailing all costs. Proposals must be submitted by September 30th, 2024, to SEDA-COG. The proposal will be evaluated based on adequacy, experience, quality, timeliness, cost, and timeline. References are required, and Professional Liability Insurance and a PA Contractors License are mandated.
